_comment: Source of truth for beam ROIs and detection thresholds.
_calibration: The 45 entries under `beams` are the RELAY WIRING RECORD: which board and channel drives which strip. Detection does not read them (ADR 0009). ROIs live under `mazes.<name>.cameras.<cam>.dots`, written by tools/capture.py, one capture per maze. Absent `mazes` means uncalibrated, and an uncalibrated preset watches nothing.
